lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl \u003cb\u003efacto:
"

The gravimetric factor converts the mass of the precipitate into mass of analyte: GF = (a · Manalyte) / Mprecipitate, where a is the number of analyte atoms per formula of the precipitate. Then % = mpp · GF / msample × 100. Compare the value obtained with the true one and discuss the errors.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl precipitado se \u0:
"

The precipitate is dried or calcined in a crucible to constant mass (two successive weighings differing by less than 0.3 mg). If moisture remains, the mass overestimates the analyte. Some precipitates must be calcined to reach a stable form (Fe(OH)₃ → Fe₂O₃).

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn el \u003cb\u003ean:
"

In gravimetric analysis the analyte is converted into an insoluble, pure precipitate of definite composition, which is weighed. Add the precipitating reagent: with an excess (≈ 100–150 %) precipitation is nearly complete; with too little, analyte remains in solution and the result comes out low.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSe calienta el precip:
"

The precipitate is heated in its mother liquor (digestion): small crystals dissolve and recrystallize into larger ones that are purer and easier to filter. It is filtered and washed to remove impurities. Coprecipitation of other ions increases the mass and gives a high result.

"
lit.\u0027«Analito», masa de muestra y error: 'the analyte, the sample mass and possible errors in the procedure.'
lit.\u0027«Masa de precipitado frente al rea: '“Mass of precipitate versus reagent added”: it stops growing when precipitation is complete.'
lit.\u0027Activa un error de coprecipitación: 'Turn on a coprecipitation error: the result comes out high.'
lit.\u0027Añade reactivo hasta que la masa d: 'Add reagent until the precipitate mass no longer changes: precipitation is complete.'
lit.\u0027Calcula el % de analito con el fac: 'Work out the % of analyte with the gravimetric factor and compare it with the panel.'
lit.\u0027El factor gravimétrico para Cl⁻ pe: "The gravimetric factor for Cl⁻ weighed as AgCl is…"
lit.\u0027El FG de Fe pesado como Fe₂O₃ (159: "The GF of Fe weighed as Fe₂O₃ (159.69 g/mol; Fe 55.845) is…"
lit.\u0027el precipitado se filtra, se seca: 'the precipitate is filtered, dried or ignited and weighed in the crucible until constant mass.'
lit.\u0027Elige el analito, la masa de muest: "Choose the analyte, the sample mass and the possible errors. The precipitate forms in the beaker and is transferred to the crucible on the balance."
lit.\u0027La digestión crece los cristales y: "Digestion grows the crystals and reduces coprecipitation"
lit.\u0027La digestión del precipitado sirve: "The digestion of the precipitate serves to…"
lit.\u0027Parte del analito queda en disoluc: "Part of the analyte stays in solution."
lit.\u0027puntos azules = analito aún disuel: 'blue dots = analyte still in solution; light spheres = precipitate forming.'
lit.\u0027Se añade un exceso de reactivo par: "An excess of reagent is added to precipitate all of the analyte"
lit.\u0027Si el reactivo precipitante es esc: "If the precipitating reagent is scarce, the result is…"
lit.\u0027Una coprecipitación de impurezas p: "A coprecipitation of impurities produces a result that is…"
